reply: The Status tab shows only roadmap steps, which live on each repo's roadmap record branch. Plans in docs/plans are not steps. They show only as a count in the Records view. So a repo with plans but no roadmap branch, or no steps on it, shows a blank Status tab. A second cause: a page republished from the plain template loses its roadmap block. I have not checked which repos hit which cause. New step roadmap-blank-pages checks each repo's page, then fixes it by building the block or making steps from the plans. It went to the coordinator at 19:06 CST.
